Register of Deeds
The Register of Deeds records deeds, mortgages, mortgage assignments, mortgage releases, easements, rights-of-way, federal and state tax liens, plats, surveys, oil and gas Leases, patents, power of attorney, documents related to corporations, death certificates, affidavits, UCC filings and numerous miscellaneous documents.
The 911 Coordinator position consists of assigning house numbers, updating mapping, assigning Emergency Service Numbers, coordinating correct responding agencies and coordinating replacement of road signs.
Genealogy Research
Custodians of the county real estate and old school records which assist individuals.
All the school genealogy records are in our computer system for easy access.
